name: Nazca Lines
description: An extensive group of pre-Columbian geoglyphs scratched into the desert pampa between the towns of Nazca and Palpa in southern Peru, created by the Paracas and Nazca cultures roughly between 500 BCE and 500 CE. Inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1994.
origin: Concentrated in the arid Pampas de Jumana plateau between Nazca and Palpa in southern Peru, approximately 400 km south of Lima.
